title: Cosmic Shadow Vortex
description: A surreal painting featuring a black shadowy silhouette with glowing blue flame-like energy emerging from its head, set against a swirling vortex of blue, purple, and pink brushstrokes. Small pink winged fairy-like figures line the spiraling ribbons that twist around the central form against a dark textured background.
prompt: surreal cosmic painting of a black shadowy silhouette with bright blue flame energy rising from its head, surrounded by dynamic spiraling ribbons of blue, purple and pink paint, small glowing pink winged fairies flying along the swirling paths, dark textured background with faint floral patterns, dramatic flowing brushstrokes, mystical atmosphere
